On an XBT Native SegWit watch-only test account with both hardware-signing switches enabled, enter a fixed Send amount and leave coin selection on automatic. If the first selection has an unsupported funding signature, RedWallet tries one other selection and verifies the inputs again.

When an alternative covers the payment and passes verification, RedWallet shows its exact network fee. Cancel to stay in Send, or confirm to review the unsigned request on Keystone. Compare the recipient, amount and fee. Stop at review. Use disposable test coins.

If RedWallet cannot verify separation, signing stays blocked. The existing notice about sharing funding transaction IDs and IP addresses with the public proof services still applies.
